hooks.name: chat_recipient
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge sends a chat line to every player; it has no per-recipient event)

rust_summary: a public chat line hidden from one receiver (`native_chat_recipient`), asked once per receiver.
doc_summary: `native_chat_recipient(sender, sender_name, message, recipient, hidden)` is asked once for each player who would receive a public chat line: a player's chat message after `native_player_chat` let it through (a message it dropped is not heard here), or a signed `/say` or `/me`. Set `hidden` to keep the line from that receiver only: the others still get it, the signed content is not changed, so its signature still verifies for them, and a hidden line is not sent to that receiver at all. Bundles need "hooks": @API:chat_recipient@.
